Label 'SCONTO % (MAX CONSENTITO 30%)' is the 'max consentito N%' string mentioned in PO — it appears near the dropdown (not on the trigger button itself). Note: the sidebar for commercial shows the emitted PDF as a 'PREVIEW' file under 'PDF EMESSI (1)' with a download link, so PDF generation itself works — only the in-modal iframe preview couldn't be confirmed from Playwright.
